name: incendiary cloud
lore:
# Codex Arcanum: Incendiary Cloud

To weave the ***Incendiary Cloud*** is to dance upon the precipice of annihilation. As the incantation peaks, the Weave feels not like silk, but like jagged obsidian—hot, prickly, and straining to expand. The caster must exert a cooling, iron-willed grip, for the magic feels like inhaling the very breath of a furnace; one slip, and the lungs might ignite before the first spark flies.

Upon manifestation, the air curdles into a roiling bank of soot-grey vapor, thick enough to choke the sun. Within this gloom, millions of white-hot embers swirl in a violent, cyclonic rhythm. It is a beautiful, terrible sight—a storm of fireflies that carries the roar of a forge.

**The Legend of Aethelgard**
Chroniclers trace this spell to the Siege of Aethelgard. When the Iron Horde breached the inner sanctum, the Archmage Valerius—wounded and cornered—refused to yield. Legend says he reached into the elemental chaos and tore out a fragment of the sun’s heart. When the smoke cleared, the fortress gates were nothing but slag and glass, and an entire legion had been reduced to drifting ash.
